text:
sam: quick check — PR #4128 is ready for a canary rollout but I'd like one more reviewer on the KV-cache TTL change and the batching heuristic tweak. small attn-kernel bounds guard included. PTAL when you get a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4128 :eyes:

maya: taking a look now, can you paste the rollout checklist here? makes it easier for me to tick items off.

sam: pasted the checklist in the PR but copying main bits here:
```
- smoke: run local small-seq smoke (run_smoke.sh -s small)
- perf: run ci/bench with 1k samples, compare p50/p95 to baseline
- canary: 10% traffic for 30m, monitor tail latency and KV hit-rate
- rollback: pin to previous model-variant and disable prefix caching if anomalies
```

oliver: quick Q: perf targets? what's acceptable delta for p95?

sam: target: p50 within 5% and p95 within 12% of current main branch. KV hit-rate should not drop more than 3%. if p95 regresses >12% we rollback.

maya: spotted a nit in the TTL tweak — may impact cold-start behavior. can we add a short note in the PR description about rationale and a metric to watch: "cold-start latency (first token p95)"?

sam: good call, added note and a prometheus query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

jen: I can run the smoke + bench in my GPU queue in ~40m and post results here. if all green I can give a review and approve.

maya: thanks — I'll skim code while jen runs bench. main things I'm looking at: KV eviction path, batcher backpressure change, and the attn guard for OOB indices.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job/ci-canary-4128 started at 2249002000, monitors: canary-latency-check, kv-hitrate-check.

jen: bench results: baseline vs pr: p50 +3%, p95 +9%, cold-start p95 +4%, kv_hit_rate -1.1%. all within thresholds. attached logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/4128/bench

maya: eyeballing code, left one small comment about a comment string, nothing blocking.

jen: after maya's comment addressed, lgtm from me.

sam: updated comment and pushed. thanks all. planning to start 10% canary in 10m. will call out if rollback needed. :thumbsup:

jen: fyi I'll be watching dashboards during the canary window.

sam: deploy started, will post updates.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 10% in progress for PR #4128 — monitoring hooks active.

sam: quick update after 15m: tail latency stable, kv hit-rate steady. continuing to 30m.

jen: ack, good so far.

sam: canary completed successfully, merging shortly unless any objections.

maya: no objections from me.

jen: no objections, go for it. :shipit:

sam: merged and rolling out to 100%. thanks everyone!
